globalStyle:
OPTION 2 — STONE & LINEN. This is a refined evolution of the warm Mineral & Walnut design, with selected substantial stone furniture and richer grounded walnut cabinetry. Quiet luxury suited to everyday life and seasonal decorating, not a generic showroom or ornate hotel. Warm mushroom/putty finely textured mineral-looking walls, warm ivory trim, natural neutral light-to-medium OAK floors, rich medium-dark cocoa WALNUT with visible matched grain, ivory/linen upholstery and tactile loose wool rugs. The walls must be subtly nuanced, NOT heavily blotched. Keep fine black/charcoal accents for structure and use polished SILVER/chrome selectively on a carefully chosen light, faucet or small detail; no brass/gold. White upholstery is warm off-white, not blue-white. Quality comes from proportion, a few strong pieces, consistent wood grain, soft edges, restrained joinery reveals and warm layered light.

All NEW freestanding drawer units, bedside cabinets, sideboards and consoles sit on continuous recessed solid PLINTHS reaching the floor: no little exposed legs, open frames, floating cabinets or hovering furniture. Add fine shadow reveals and quality grain, not flat brown generic boxes. A light honed warm-taupe stone top on selected pieces. CHAIRS and practical desks may have supports; do not turn every object into a solid block. Rich stone coffee table with softly rounded corners where appropriate. Ready-made/modular-looking construction with selective built-in work, no extravagant new ceilings or wall demolition. Preserve existing service locations. Primary and secondary bedrooms retain individual identities described below, not identical furniture sets.

Green comes from living PLANTS ONLY, thoughtfully placed without blocking doors or glazing. Most artwork is warm white/taupe/charcoal, distinct related pieces rather than identical prints. Small smoky blue notes are allowed in a single artwork or textile; at most one muted butter-yellow small cushion or ceramic item in the designated rooms. Permanent walls/cabinetry remain neutral. No whole-room blue/green walls, no matching blue/yellow accessory kit. No holiday decorations in the base design. Sheers are fine ivory ripple-fold; layered warm light without orange color cast. Photoreal architecture magazine photography, believable material texture and residential scale, clear natural daylight. No people, logos, watermarks or labels; only preserve expressly requested room inscriptions.
